tag.quark.vertical_slabs.description: Half of a normal block, rotated. Great for texturing builds.
lore.architects_palette.algal_blend: A mix of Clay and Kelp. Smelt it into Algal Bricks.
lore.architects_palette.algal_brick: A brick fired from Algal Blend. Used for Algal building blocks and lamps.
lore.architects_palette.algal_lamp: A glowing block made from Algal Bricks and Citrine.
lore.architects_palette.sunmetal_block: A polished building block made from Bronze Ingots.
lore.architects_palette.chiseled_sunmeta: A block of Polished Bronze with a chiseled pattern.
lore.architects_palette.nether_brass_ble: A mix of Soul Sand, Copper, and Iron. Smelt it into Nether Brass.
lore.architects_palette.nether_brass_tor: A torch that burns with Nether Brass's eerie green flame.
lore.architects_palette.withered_bone: A charred bone dropped by Wither Skeletons. Builds Withered Bone blocks, or can be smelted into Black Dye.
lore.architects_palette.wither_lamp: A glowing lamp made from Withered Bones and Citrine.
lore.architects_palette.osseous_skull: A carved bone block in the shape of a skull. Add a Torch to light it up.
lore.architects_palette.lit_osseous_skul: A carved bone skull with a Torch burning inside.
lore.architects_palette.withered_osseous: A carved Withered Bone block in the shape of a skull. Add a Soul Torch to light it up.
lore.architects_palette.lit_withered_oss: A carved Withered Bone skull with a Soul Torch burning inside.
lore.architects_palette.entwine_rod: A rod made from a Wanderer Pearl bound in Iron. Used for Entwine blocks and bars.
lore.architects_palette.entwine_block: A block woven from Entwine Rods.
lore.architects_palette.chiseled_entwine: A block of Entwine with a chiseled pattern.
lore.architects_palette.entwine_bars: Decorative bars made of Entwine Rods.
lore.architects_palette.unobtanium: A mysterious metal made by warping Infernite through a Nether Portal.
lore.architects_palette.ender_pearl_bloc: A compact block of nine Wanderer Pearls.
lore.architects_palette.warpstone: A strange stone made by tossing Clay through a Nether Portal.
lore.architects_palette.onyx: A dark stone made by tossing Granite through a Nether Portal.
lore.architects_palette.nebulite: A speckled stone made by tossing Diorite through a Nether Portal.
lore.architects_palette.moonshale: A pale stone made by tossing Stone through a Nether Portal.
lore.architects_palette.craterstone: A pitted stone made by tossing Cobblestone through a Nether Portal. Smelt it into Moonshale.
lore.architects_palette.entrails: A grisly block made by tossing a Rotten Flesh block through a Nether Portal.
lore.architects_palette.plating_block: An industrial block of riveted Iron plating.
lore.architects_palette.tread_plate: Iron plating with a grippy tread pattern.
lore.architects_palette.hazard_block: A striped warning block made from yellow and black Concrete.
lore.architects_palette.sheet_metal_bloc: A block of thin Iron sheeting.
lore.architects_palette.ancient_plating: Ornate plating made from Nether Brass and Ancient Scrap.
lore.architects_palette.pipe: A decorative Iron pipe that connects to other pipes.
lore.architects_palette.salmon_scales: A decorative block covered in salmon scales.
lore.architects_palette.cod_scales: A decorative block covered in cod scales.
lore.architects_palette.chiseled_gilded_: Gilded Sandstone with a chiseled pattern.
lore.architects_palette.coarse_snow: Snow mixed with Gravel for a firmer, rougher surface.
lore.architects_palette.bread_block: A giant loaf of Bread, purely for decoration.
lore.architects_palette.crustless_bread_: A giant loaf of Bread with its crust trimmed off.
lore.architects_palette.charcoal_block: A compact block of nine Charcoal. It burns for a long time.
lore.architects_palette.calcite_lamp: A glowing lamp made from Calcite.
lore.architects_palette.tuff_lamp: A glowing lamp made from Tuff.
lore.architects_palette.dripstone_lamp: A glowing lamp made from Dripstone.
lore.architects_palette.polished_packed_: Packed Ice that has been polished smooth.
lore.architects_palette.chiseled_packed_: Packed Ice with a chiseled pattern.
lore.architects_palette.oracle_jelly: A sweet jelly made from Chorus Fruit, Amethyst, and Sugar.
lore.architects_palette.acacia_totem_win: A carved wing that attaches to the side of an Acacia Totem.
